newsitem.title: FINLAND: SILJA SAYS W.QUEEN FIRE TO HAVE NO IMPACT.
newsitem.headline: SILJA SAYS W.QUEEN FIRE TO HAVE NO IMPACT.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy Ab said on Wednesday there had been a small fire on its Wasa Queen ferry, which is docked for service, but the fire had caused only minor damage and would not affect the ferry's operations.
"The value of the damages is some 200,000 markka," Silja Line technical director Joachim Grasbeck told Reuters by telephone, adding that insurance will cover the losses.
"The ferry can return to traffic on January 16 as planned," he added.
The fire, probably sparked by welding, damaged two cabins, Grasbeck said.
Wasa Queen is operating on the Helsinki-Tallinn route.
